verdict.rationale: ADK says it is 'designed to be written by both humans and AI.' You can connect a coding assistant to ADK developer Skills and use an AI-enabled environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate and deploy through Agents CLI. That gives natural-language operation, but only through an external coding assistant, not a native natural-language command interface. The rest of the pack covers agents that answer natural language at runtime (and code-free YAML Agent Config), which is not the same as operating the product itself. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface for the framework or CLI, detailed docs on what the developer Skills cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
